pages.text: Four structure mods rework the sea floor. They are destinations for a $(l:ocean/submarines)submarine$(/l): ruins, wrecks and monuments with better loot than vanilla. Pressure matters, so check depth with a Barometer first.

pages.title: Ocean Monuments
pages.text: YUNG's Better Ocean Monuments rebuilds the vanilla monument. Prismarine can be crushed for lapis and XP.

$(thing)Hopo Better Underwater Ruins$() and $(thing)Revamped Shipwrecks$() both replace vanilla ruins and shipwrecks with larger, more varied builds. $(thing)MOS (Moog's Ocean Structures)$() adds many more: Atlantis ruins, temples, sunken ships, dragon skeletons, gardens and shrines.

Chests in them are normal loot, so remember $(l:exploration/lootr)Lootr$(/l): in this pack, loot chests are per player. Conduit and prismarine gear from these places feeds the machines in $(l:ocean/conduits)Conduit Cages$(/l).

pages.title: Conduit
pages.text: A conduit in a monument can be worked with Aquatic Ambitions' fan channeling.
